text.body: śābarīkavacam atha dhyānam oṃ namo bhagavate śrīvīrabhadrāya | virupākṣī laṃ nikuṃbhinī ṣoḍaśī upacāriṇī | varuthinī māṃsacarviṇī | ceṃ, ceṃ, ceṃ, cāmalarāyai | dhanaṃ dhanaṃ kaṃpa kaṃpa āveśaya | trilokavarti lokadāyai | sahastrakoṭidevānāṃ ākarṣaya ākarṣaya | navakoṭī gaṃdharvānāṃ ākarṣaya ākarṣaya | haṃsaḥ, haṃsaḥ, sohaṃ, sohaṃ, sarva rakṣa, māṃ rakṣa, bhūtebhyo rakṣa | grahebhyo rakṣa | piśācebhyā rakṣa | śākinītī rakṣa, ḍākinītī rakṣa | apratyakṣa pratyakṣāriṣṭebhyo rakṣa, rakṣa, | mahāśakti rakṣa | kavacaśakti rakṣa | rakṣa ojaṃvāla | guruvāla | oṃ prasaha hanumaṃta rakṣa | śrīmannāthagurutrayaṃ gaṇapatiṃ pīṭhatrayaṃ bhairava || siddhāḍhyaṃ baṭukatraya padayugaṃ dyutitrkaṃmaṃ maṃḍala || vairāṭāṣṭacatuṣṭayaṃ ca nakkaṃ vairāvalī paṃcakaṃ | śrīmanmālinīmaṃtrarājasahitaṃ vaṃde guromaṃḍalam | iti dhyānam || atha prārthanā | oṃ r‍hāṃ, r‍hīṃ, r‍hṛṃ, kṣāṃ, kṣīṃ, kṣuṃ | kṛṣṇakṣetrapālāya namaḥ āgaccha āgaccha | balī sarvagrahaśamana mama kāryaṃ kuru kuru svāhā | oṃ namo oṃ r‍hīṃ, śrīṃ, klīṃ, aiṃ, cakreśrvarī | śaṃkhacakra gadā padmadhāriṇī | mama vāṃchita siddhiṃ kuru kuru svāhā | oṃ namo kamalavadana mohinī sarvajanavaśakāriṇī sākṣāt | sūkṣmasvarupiṇī yanmama vaśagā oṃ surāturā bhaveyuḥ svāhā | gururbrahmā gururviṣṇu gururdevo maheśrvaraḥ | guru sākṣāt parabrahma tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || ajñānatimirāṃdhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā | cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || aruṇakiraṇa jālaṃ raṃjitā sāvakāśā | vidhṛtajapamālā vīṭikā pustakahastā | itarakarakarāḍhyā phullakalhāra hastā | nivasatu hṛdi bālā nityakalyāṇaśīlā || atha śābarīkavacajape viniyogaḥ || || śrī || || atha śābarīkavacapāṭhaprāraṃbhaḥ || oṃ sarvavighnanāśāya | sarvāriṣṭa nivāraṇāya | sarva saukhyapradāya | bālānāṃ buddhipradāya | nānāprakārakadhanavāhana bhūmipradāya | manovāṃchitaphalapradāya | rakṣāṃ kuru kuru svāhā | oṃ guruve namaḥ | oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ | oṃ bala bhadrāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīrāmāya namaḥ | oṃ hanumate namaḥ | oṃ śivāya namaḥ | oṃ jagannāthāya namaḥ | oṃ badrinārāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ durgādevyai namaḥ | oṃ sūryāya namaḥ | oṃ caṃdrāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaumāya namaḥ | oṃ budhāya namaḥ | oṃ guruve namaḥ | oṃ bhṛgave namaḥ | oṃ śanaiśrvarāya namaḥ | oṃ rāhave namaḥ | oṃ pucchanāyakāya namaḥ | oṃ navagraha rakṣā kuru kuru namaḥ | oṃ manye varaṃ hariharādaya evaṃ dṛṣṭvā | dṛṣṭeṣu hṛdayaṃ tvayi toṣametiḥ | kiṃ vīkṣitena bhavatā bhuvi aena nānyaḥ kaśrcit mano harati nātha bhavānata ehi | oṃ namaḥ śrīmanbalabhadrajayavijaya aparājita bhadraṃ bhadraṃ kuru kuru svāhā | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt || sarvavighnaśāṃti kuru kuru svāhā | oṃ aiṃ, r‍hīṃ, klīṃ, śrī baṭukabhairavāya | āpaduddharaṇāya | mahānabhasyāya svarupāya | dīrghāriṣṭaṃ vināśaya vināśaya | nānāprakārabhogapradāya | mama sarvāriṣṭaṃ hana hana | paca paca, hara hara, kaca kaca, rājadvāre jayaṃ kuru kuru | vyavahāre lābhaṃ vardhaya vardhaya | raṇe śatruṃ vināśaya vināśaya | anāpattiyogaṃ nivāraya nivāraya | saṃtatyutpattiṃ kuru kuru | pūrṇa āyuḥ kuru kuru | strīprāptiṃ kuru kuru | huṃ phaṭ svāhā || oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya namaḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate viśrvamūrtaye nārāyaṇāya | śrīpuruṣottamāya rakṣa rakṣa | yuṣmadadhīnaṃ pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ vā | ajīrṇa paca paca | viśrvamūrte arīn hana hana | ekāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ, tryāhikaṃ, cāturthikaṃ jvaraṃ nāśaya nāśaya | caturadhikānvātān aṣṭādaśakṣayarogān, aṣṭādaśakuṣṭān hana hana| sarvadoṣān bhaṃjaya bhaṃjaya | tatsarvaṃ nāśaya nāśaya | śoṣaya śoṣaya, ākarṣaya ākarṣaya | mama śatruṃ māraya māraya | uccāṭaya uccāṭaya, vidveṣaya vidveṣaya | staṃbhaya staṃbhaya, nivāraya nivāraya | vighnān hana hana | daha daha, paca paca, matha matha, vidhvaṃsaya vidhvaṃsaya, vidrāvaya vidrāvaya cakraṃ gṛhītvā śīghramāgacchāgaccha cakreṇa hana hana | para vidyā chedaya chedaya | caturaśīticeṭakān visphoṭaya nāśaya nāśaya | vātaśūlābhihata dṛṣṭīn | sarpasiṃhavyāghradvipadacatuṣpadāna | apare bāhyāṃtarā dibhuvyaṃtarikṣagān | anyānapi kaśrcit deśakālasthān | sarvān hana hana | viṣamameghanadīparvatādīn | aṣṭavyādhīn sarvasthānāni rātridinapathaga corān vaśamānaya vaśamānaya | sarvopadravān nāśaya nāśaya | parasainyaṃ vidāraya vidāraya paracakraṃ nivāraya nivāraya | daha daha rakṣāṃ kuru kuru | oṃ namo bhagavate oṃ namo nārāyaṇa huṃ phaṭ svāhā | ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ oṃ r‍hāṃ r‍hīṃ hṛdaye svadevatā || eṣā vidyā mahānāmnī purā dattā śatakratoḥ | asurān hantu hatvā tān sarvāśrca balidānavān | yaḥ pumān paṭhate nityaṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ niyatātmavān | tasya sarvān hiṃsatī yasyā dṛṣṭigataṃ viṣam | anyādṛṣṭiviṣaṃ caiva na deyaṃ saṃkrame dhruvam | saṃgrāme dhārayatyaṃge utpātaśamanī svayam || saubhāgyaṃ jāyate tasya paramaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | hūte sadyo jayastasya vighnaṃ tasya na jāyate | kimatra bahunoktena sarvasaubhāgyasaṃpadaḥ | labhate nātra saṃdeho nānyathā nadite bhavet || gṛhīto yadi vā yatnaṃ bālānāṃ vividhairapi | śītaṃ coṣṇatāṃ yāti uṣṇaḥ śītamayo bhavet || nānyathā śruyate vidyāṃ yaḥ paṭhet kathitāṃ mayā | bhūrjapatre likhedyaṃtra gorocanamayena ca | imāṃ vidyāṃ śirobaṃdhātsarvarakṣāṃ karonu me | puruṣasyāthavā nāryā haste badhvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | vidravaṃti praṇaśyaṃti dharmastiṣṭhati nityaśaḥ | sarvaśatrubhayaṃ yāti śīghraṃ te ca palāyitāḥ || oṃ aiṃ, r‍hīṃ, klīṃ, śrīṃ bhuvaneśrvaryai | śrīṃ oṃ bhairavāya namo namaḥ | atha śrīmātaṃgībhedā, dvāviṃśākṣaro maṃtraḥ | samukhyāyāṃ svāhāto vā || hariḥ oṃ ucciṣṭadevyai namaḥ | ḍākinī sumukhidevyai mahāpiśācinī | oṃ aiṃ, r‍hīṃ, ṭhāḥ, ṭhaḥ dvāviṃśat oṃ cakrīdharāyāḥ | ahaṃ rakṣāṃ kuru kuru | sarvabādhāhariṇī devyai namo namaḥ | sarvaprakāra bādhāśamanaṃ, ariṣṭanivāraṇaṃ kuru kuru | phaṭ, śrī oṃ kubjikādevyai r‍hīṃ ṭhaḥ svaḥ | śīghraṃ ariṣṭanivāraṇa kuru kuru | devī śābarī kīṃ ṭhaḥ, svaḥ | śārīrikaṃ bhedāhaṃ māyā bhedaya pūrṇa āyuḥ kuru | hemavatī mūlarakṣāṃ kuru | cāmuṃḍāyai devyai namaḥ | śīghraṃ vighnanivāraṇaṃ sarvavāyukaphapittarakṣāṃ kuru | bhūtapretapiśācān ghātaya | jādūṭoṇāśamanaṃ kuru | satī sarasvatyai caṃḍikādevyai galaṃ visphoṭakān, vīkṣitya śamanaṃ kuru | mahājvarakṣayaṃ kuru svāhā | sarvasāmagrī bhoga satyaṃ, divase divase, dehi dehi rakṣāṃ kuru kuru | kṣaṇe kṣaṇe, ariṣṭaṃ nivāraya | divase divase, duḥkhaharaṇaṃ, maṃgalakaraṇaṃ, kāryāsiddhiṃ kuru kuru | hari oṃ śrīrāmacaṃdrāya namaḥ | hariḥ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ caṃdratārānavagrahaśeṣanāgapṛthvīdevyai ākāśanivāsinī sarvāriṣṭaśamanaṃ kuru svāhā || āyurārogyamaiśrvaryaṃ vittaṃ jñānaṃ yaśobalam || nābhimātrajale sthitvā sahastraparisaṃkhyayā || japetkavacamidaṃ nityaṃ vācāṃ siddhirbhave ttataḥ || anena vidhinā bhaktyākavacasiddhiśrca jāyate || śatamāvartayedyustu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || sarvavyādhibhayasthāne manasā ' sya tu ciṃtanam || rājāno vaśyatāṃ yāṃti sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || anena yathāśaktipāṭhena śābarīdevī prīyatāṃ namama || śubhaṃ bhavatu || iti śābarīkavacaṃ ||
